RebelFunnels.ManageFunnelsIntro: A funnel counts how many visits get through a list of steps in order, and where they leave. A visit enters at the first step and reaches a step only after the step before it. Other pages in between are fine.
RebelFunnels.MaxStepsReached: A funnel can have at most %s steps.
RebelFunnels.PreviewHint: The last 7 days, counted from the raw data.
RebelFunnels.PreviewNeedsSteps: Give every step a name and every rule a value to see the preview.
RebelFunnels.Reorder: Drag, or use the up and down arrow keys, to reorder
RebelFunnels.SegmentFilterHelp: Optional. A segment the whole funnel is restricted to.
RebelFunnels.SettingMaxStepsHelp: How many steps a funnel can have at most. Each step is one query when a day is archived.
RebelFunnels.StepsHelp: A visit reaches a step with an action that matches any of the step's rules. Upper and lower case make no difference, and URLs are compared without "https://" and "www.".
RebelFunnels.TestUrlHelp: Paste a page URL to see which steps it matches.
RebelFunnels.UpdateWarning: Saving this change builds the data of the funnel again, for the last %s months. Older data of the funnel is removed.
